current.text: He is a projected starter for the Knicks, next to Brunson, Hart, Anunoby and Towns.
Over the last third of last season he played under 30 minutes, took about one free throw per game and had a usage rate around 16 percent. He was benched at times.
Several experts say he was not worth a roster spot in standard category leagues for the final two to three months of last season. He ranked around 130th per game.
Gavin expects the same limited role this season but still his best season as a Knick. Mike Brown may cut his role if he struggles.
Experts agree he is overdrafted. Do not take him at ESPN category rank 29 or around Yahoo rank and ADP 73 to 79.
Experts value him far below his ranks: Josh sees him as about a 2 USD auction player, and other experts place him in the 90s or outside the top 100.
The Knicks are expected to be cautious after their title run: trimmed starter minutes and more rest on back-to-backs over the first 30 or so games.
The Knicks are the defending champions and are projected for about 50 to 54 wins.

durable.text: He is an elite off-ball defender.
He is very durable and rarely misses games.
He can be projected for more games than the usual player, though Josh warns that any player can still get hurt and miss a large part of a season.
He is a low-volume player with good percentages and some steals. No category is a real outlier, and none is clearly weak.
His rankings rest on games played and season totals. Per game he is not that good, so nine-cat totals flatter him.

note: ESPN values him at 26 USD (12 USD average cost) and Yahoo at 12 USD (2.8 USD average cost). He went for 9 USD in our league last season. Experts put him near 2 USD, because his per-game line was waiver level late last season (under 30 minutes, about 16 percent usage). He has no weak category, so he can fill a forward spot in any build, but only bid a few dollars and let others pay for his games played. Early in the season, check his minutes and shot volume while the Knicks trim starter minutes over the first 30 or so games.
